title: Three Winters and One Short Nail
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·绘画与艺术）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·绘画与艺术）　|　核心词汇：frame　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 frame 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the painter ① made a frame that no visitor in the studio would have named, and he said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② frame, meaning the border itself and not the picture, ran three winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a frame, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ frame in that studio had the same short nail beside it, and the ④ frame at the far wall, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A frame, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the painter said the naming is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the frame was the whole of the matter, meaning the body and not the border. The ⑥ frame, meaning the body and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; frame, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a border and a body. He said the body is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ frame had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short nail. The ⑧ frame of the whole thing, the painter wrote in January, was one studio and three winters of naming; frame, he said, is either the one at the far wall or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ frame I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ frame, my mother said in 1977, is the only one that improves by being named; every frame, she said, is a body that has agreed to look like a border. She said the body was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 画框；框子（指画室里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 画框（指那一只本身，与画作相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a frame 做一只画框
D. n. 画框（指留给孩子们的那一类）
E. n. 画框（抽象总称，指一间画室的做框之事）
F. n. 画框（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一只）
G. n. 体格；身躯（his frame，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 体格（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

answers.why: make a frame 意为“做一只画框”，1966 年那位画师做了一只画室里没有一位访客肯说出名字的画框。
frame 意为“画框”，指那一只本身而不是画作，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
frame 意为“画框”，指画室里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一枚短短的钉子。
frame 意为“画框”，指留给孩子们的那一类，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
frame 意为“体格、身躯”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这副身躯就是那件事的全部。
frame 意为“体格”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那只画框，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
frame 意为“画框”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一只，到 1973 年这一只成了计划里的一行。
frame 意为“画框”，画师一月写道，整件事的做框之事是一间画室和三个冬天的说出名字。
frame 意为“画框”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一只，1975 年结束了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一只。
frame 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，一只画框是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
